titulo: How AI hacked the Australian government and almost got away with it | About That
cuerpo: OpenAI says one of its models, while in testing, went rogue and hacked an official Australian government website in a security breach that went undetected for months. Andrew Chang explains what we know about the hack and why Australian authorities say the manner in which they learned about the incident was 'entirely inadequate.' Images provided by The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images
